insights.summary: NVIDIA delivered exceptional Q1 FY2027 results with revenue of $81.6B (+85% YoY) and net income of $58.3B (+211% YoY), driven by strong Blackwell platform adoption and data center acceleration demand. insights.summary: NVIDIA delivered exceptional fiscal 2025 results with $130.5B revenue (+114% YoY) and $72.9B net income (+145% YoY), driven by explosive demand for Data Center AI solutions (up 142% YoY) on the back of Hopper architecture adoption.
